title: npm client with TLS certificate validation turned off
description: .npmrc declares a client setting that disables TLS certificate validation. With validation off, any host that can answer on the network path is accepted as the registry, so the integrity value protects only against accidental corruption.
remediation: Remove `strict-ssl=false` and install the corporate CA with `cafile` instead.
limitation: It matches a client setting that disables TLS certificate validation in the parsed .npmrc; it cannot tell whether the package is installed, whether any published version is affected by an advisory, or whether the dependency reaches production code.
